sandbachFocus: Sandbach United suffered a disappointing 1-3 defeat to New Mills in midweek on August 11, with the visitors capitalizing on set-piece opportunities and an awkward bounce that caught the Bach defence out. Despite squandering chances and hitting the bar through Hatton, Sandbach couldn't find a way through. This weekend they turn their attention to cup football, hosting Ashby Ivanhoe in the FA Vase first qualifying round at 3pm.
divisionWide: Wolverhampton Casuals' unbeaten start came to an end with a 2-1 midweek loss to Eccleshall, who pulled off an impressive away victory. Eccleshall themselves now face Allscott Heath in FA Vase action this weekend. Stafford Town bounced back impressively from their Sandbach loss, dismantling Alsager 3-2 in midweek despite going down to ten men, with goals from Lynch, Mazurkiewicz and Greer. AFC Bridgnorth remain in contention at the summit with their unbeaten league record intact, preparing to host Crewe this weekend. New Mills continue their strong form after their victory at Sandbach, and face Northwich Victoria in the FA Vase. Shawbury United battled Allscott Heath in a seven-goal thriller, losing 3-4 in midweek despite taking the lead, and will host Widnes Town on Saturday. Foley Meir secured an impressive 3-0 away win at Crewe with goals from Fin Foote and two from Freddie Lloyd. Telford Town won their midweek cup replay against Market Drayton (1-0), and face Darlaston in the FA Vase this weekend. Brereton Social remain unbeaten in the league and host Bilston Town on Saturday in their first home fixture.
